Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Tanay - 8 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
4. Sharda - 67 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anita and Tanay stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Nikhil searches for his lost ball.]

Nikhil: "Really?"

[Nikhil trips over a stone.]

Nikhil: "Wow, how lovely!"

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Nikhil (laughing): "I'm ready!"

[Flower petals rain down on Nikhil.]

Anita (happily): "Okay, Nikhil."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil lies down on the sofa.]

Nikhil: "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil sits down on a chair.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Nikhil (happily): "One more time!"

[Nikhil sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Anita: "What a day to remember!"
